executed_implementation.negative_control: deterministic within-role permutation of TRAIN-fitted participant score values across participant identities

impact: The executed participant lane does not exactly implement the frozen participant baseline or placebo. Its raw statistics, BH result, controls and BUILD-008 report are retained as audit evidence but cannot be treated as confirmatory evidence for the preregistered PARTICIPANT-001 hypothesis.
fdr_note: The original 25-test BH table is retained unchanged for audit. PARTICIPANT-001@300s is only a nominal rejection under the executed implementation; it is not a valid preregistered discovery claim.
remediation: Do not retroactively amend and re-promote EXPERIMENT-003 after outcome exposure. Any corrected participant test must be a new preregistered experiment. Post-hoc participant diagnostics remain exploratory only.
